concept: A bright pocket-city terrace that turns urban wandering, skyline energy, and warm windows into a welcoming habitat.
floor: One broad continuous blue-gray city-terrace floor across the full top face, formed from six to eight oversized smooth slabs without roads, crosswalks, cracks, or small paving texture.
main_structure: One compact rounded art-deco city pavilion at the rear, formed from a tall central tower and two broad stepped side buildings with a few oversized amber windows.
rear_props: one broad curved city bench beneath the skyline
side_props: one chunky planter with a single rounded street tree on the upper-left edge
one compact blank transit shelter and one large planter on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth slate-blue city parapet with broad rounded capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple gold window-light blocks

lighting: clear soft daylight with three or four broad pools of warm amber window and lantern glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open city-terrace floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, road, crosswalk, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, traffic, vehicles, text, signs with writing, watermark, external shadow
tiny window grids, bricks, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
